component.name: GeoConveyor
component.summary: Batch geospatial processing, folder in, folder out

description.p: GeoConveyor is a native batch front end for the terrio command-line tool. Pick an input folder and an output folder, choose a function, and every matching file is processed in parallel: convert, reproject, mosaic, rasterize, polygonize, DEM, calc and more.
It needs terrio installed on the host system (see terrio.opengeos.org; on Linux: curl -LsSf https://terrio.opengeos.org/install.sh | sh).
Input-type filtering on Convert, parallel sessions, Settings (tab order, light/dark, language), and English, Spanish, French and German.
